releases.title: six themes, the newsroom's five mapped onto RiskMandate's look plus its own dark; the header fits an iPad
releases.notes: A theme pill in the header picks one of six, kept in this browser: RiskMandate (the default, riskmandate.ai's paper and green), Canvas (its dark, from the dark hero band), and newsroom.sgit.ai's Night, Ember, Paper and Blueprint, mapped onto this site's tokens. Every colour now lives in assets/themes.css and nowhere else; site.css reads tokens only. A new test fails the build on a theme missing a token, a colour written outside that file, or a pair under its contrast in any theme; it found riskmandate.ai's green at 4.24:1 on its own alternate band, so the link accent is one shade darker. The header lost the first-batch stage pill, gained the picker beside the version, and now folds its links behind the menu button below 1100px: between 1040 and 1200 the version chip used to run past the right edge and the page scrolled sideways, which is an iPad in landscape. Wide tables scroll inside themselves on a phone instead of widening the customers page. docs/ops/themes.md says how it works and how to add a seventh.

releases.title: the repository moved to Risk-Mandate; the source links and the DNS target follow it
releases.notes: The lead moved the repository from the SGit-AI organisation to Risk-Mandate/Risk-Mandate-AI__Website__Customers between the first push and the first CI run, and pointed customers.riskmandate.ai at risk-mandate.github.io. Every source link on the site, the release script's Actions lookup, the participant disclosure and the DNS line in needs.md now name the new home; the corrections file records the move as C9. Nothing else changed.

releases.title: the first customers site: the brief, the start-here page, the batch, the steps and the gate
releases.notes: The site exists, as customers.riskmandate.ai, a sub-site of riskmandate.ai, built from the newsroom brief of 20 October 2026 and the voice memo that followed it the same day. What is here: the brief published in full with its corrections file beside it; a start-here page in order; the programme pages (customers not beta users, credit and the meter, the seven milestone steps, the daily follow-up, what we want to discover, the next batch); a page per customer generated from data/customers.json with no contact details in it; the reality file; the team as files; the review folder with the brief as intent; and the eight-check gate with a leak tripwire and the house words. What is not here: the meter (the newsroom's, not yet wired to this site), a form, any customer's private details, and the derived half of the review folder. Every number on a page is counted from a file.
